title: When Do Foundation Models Pay Off for Retail Demand Forecasting? v1.12 Benchmark Study with TimesFM fev-bench WAPE Covariance
description: v1.12 release package for a retail demand forecasting benchmark study of foundation models and conventional baselines, supported by a structured literature search. This version includes official fev-bench retail WAPE prediction-level covariance artifacts for TimesFM 2.5, Seasonal Naive, Chronos-Bolt-Tiny, Chronos-2, and TiRex across all 20 retail tasks, plus a Source B 10-trial tuned recursive LightGBM comparator on the matched M5/Rohlik/Favorita panels. The package includes the manuscript PDF, LaTeX source, extraction/provenance tables, release audits, fev-bench WAPE covariance artifacts, Source B matched-panel artifacts, LightGBM tuning-trial logs, and replication code. SQL, MASE, GIFT-Eval, tuned direct baselines, GPU throughput, covariate-aware FM variants, and additional independent benchmark suites remain outside the current covariance evidence.
notes: GitHub release asset: zenodo-v1.12-timesfm-fev-bench-wape-covariance-repair.zip; source commit recorded in COMMIT.txt inside the archive; file hashes recorded in CHECKSUMS.txt inside the archive.
